units.source_text: 现在，此时此刻，我听到你从天国表白的爱，

en.t: Now, at this very moment, I hear the love you confess from heaven,

units.source_text: 我想，与其在阴府或来世成为你的恋人，

en.t: and I think that rather than becoming your lover in the underworld or in the next life,

units.source_text: 不如你和我都变成红梅或夹竹桃，

en.t: it would be far better for you and me both to become red plum blossoms or oleanders,

units.source_text: 让运送花粉的蝴蝶为我们撮合会好得多。

en.t: and let the butterflies that carry pollen bring us together.
